text_simplified:
After the spouses come together upon righteousness and piety, the second pillar comes: instilling sound aqeedah and faith in the hearts of children.
Sound aqeedah is to righteous deeds and noble akhlaq as a foundation is to a building, and as the root of the good, firm tree that yields its fruits at all times. And when aqeedah weakens, morals become shaken and weak.
